## Definition of Done (TRY-BNP-DEV-01)

- [ ] Docs / ADRs updated (frozen contracts version-bumped if touched)
- [ ] Tests pass (unit / integration / e2e where relevant)
- [ ] Lint passes (no warnings)
- [ ] Typecheck passes (no `any`)
- [ ] Accessibility checked (keyboard + axe)
- [ ] Performance checked (no N+1 / needless client JS)
- [ ] Security reviewed (authz, validation, no secret/PII leak)
